tool_config.name: transfer_to_office
tool_config.description: Tell the office that the Foreman is being put through, just before you transfer the call with transfer_to_number. The office gets a dashboard pop-up and the on-duty Coordinator gets a text naming the Foreman, the Job and what it is about. Returns {"ok": true}, or {"error": "..."} if the office could not be told; transfer the call either way.

request_body_schema.description: Only what the Foreman already said on this call. Never ask for any of it; send none of them if he said nothing yet.

reason.description: What the Foreman wants to talk to the office about, or the need he was giving you, in his words. Leave it out if he has not said.

job_id.description: The job_id find_jobs returned for the Job the Foreman named. Leave it out unless find_jobs returned exactly one Job.

job_spoken.description: The Job in the Foreman's own words, if he named one. Leave it out if he did not.
